messages:
IncidentBot: SEV2 page: embed-service 503s (us-west-2). Affected: Dedicated customers with heavy batched requests. Auto-escalation -> eng-oncall. Start ts=1939999999

Leah H: seeing increased 503 rate and latency spikes in embed-service, confirm impact?

Kevin M: yep, dashboards show 503 spike starting ~1939999800, error budget burn for a couple of customers. routing fallback kicked in for hosted but Dedicated traffic stayed on primary pool.

Samir (oncall): I’m on it. quick triage — could be kv-cache eviction spike after a hot restart. pulling logs now. @Maya S any customer-reported incidents?

Maya S (CS): reported via support ticket — Customer Alpha reports service errors in production; they’re seeing retries that cause visible user errors. I’ve told them we’re investigating, they want ETA.

Leah H: thanks. Samir, check node restarts + autoscaler events. If autoscaler bounced instances with cold KV caches that could explain 503s under batched loads.

Samir (oncall): grep logs for oom/evict and autoscaler events. current findings:
```
[warn] 1939999811 kvcache: eviction triggered: size=1.1GB -> 0.9GB
[error] 1939999815 http: 503 embed-request batch-handler timeout
[info] 1939999822 autoscaler: scale-down -> requested=2 -> actual=1
```
Looks like a concurrent scale-down and heavy batched traffic window. One of the GPU workers returned 503s while cache warmed.

Kevin M: that aligns. Mitigation plan: 1) bump min replicas on dedicated pools to prevent scale-down during business hours for impacted customers, 2) add a short warmup/prime step before routing traffic to newly started workers, 3) immediate rollback of a recent autoscaler config change if it was applied.

Leah H: for live mitigation — do a manual scale-up to 3 replicas in pool for the affected customer, route traffic to warmed nodes. Samir, can you do the scale-up and hold?

Samir (oncall): scaling to 3 now. holding new routing until KV cache warm: running warmup script.

Samir (oncall): warmup script output:
```
> curl -X POST http://worker-local/warmup -d '{"prefixes": ["/alpha-customer/"]}'
warming 12 prefixes, took ~18s, KV hit-rate increased to 87% on new node
```
New node marked healthy; routing restored. 503 rate dropping.

Maya S (CS): Customer Alpha says errors reduced and RM appreciates the quick response. They asked for a postmortem and assurance this won’t recur.

Leah H: good. we’ll schedule a post-incident review. Proposed owners: Leah (incident lead), Samir (root cause & remediation), Kevin (infra/autoscaler changes), Maya (customer comms).

Kevin M: immediate action items from triage:
- AI-1: revert recent autoscaler aggressive scale-down policy applied yesterday (assigned Kevin)
- AI-2: add a 60s cooldown or prevent scale-down when per-pool QPS > X (assigned Kevin)
- AI-3: implement warmup endpoint + automated warmup hook on instance readiness (assigned Samir)
- AI-4: create runbook note for oncall describing warmup and manual scale steps (assigned Leah)
- AI-5: CS follow-up + postmortem summary to customer (assigned Maya)

Samir (oncall): I’ll open PR for warmup hook and add unit + integration test for KV warmup behavior. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Leah H: Kevin, can you revert autoscaler change now?

Kevin M: reverted in config repo, deployed via canary; will monitor. Also added a temporary safety flag to avoid scale-down below min-replicas for Dedicated pools.

IncidentBot: Update: alert rate returning to normal. Closing on-call page and creating post-incident thread: thread_ts=1939999999.

Leah H: scheduling postmortem sync. Propose timeline:
- Draft postmortem doc by 1940002000 (48h)
- Postmortem review meeting (brown bag) on 1940005600 (in 4 days) — 30m slot to cover timeline, root cause, remediation, and prevention patterns.

Maya S (CS): I’ll draft the executive customer note and share a version of the postmortem with sensitive sections redacted for the customer.

Kevin M: for remediation tracking, I made a tracking board card: "Embed service warmup + autoscaler safeguards". Will link PRs and mark subtasks (AI-2, AI-3).

Samir (oncall): quick notes for postmortem: root cause = scale-down during bursty batched traffic + cold KV leading to transient 503s; contributing factor = missing warmup hook and autoscaler thresholds tuned for average load not bursty pattern.

Leah H: action item owners, add ETA and PR links to card by EOD tomorrow so we can close loop in postmortem. Also include a short playbook snippet for oncall to run the warmup script and manual routing change.

Maya S (CS): customer follow-up plan: send interim update in 2 hours, postmortem within 48 hours, and offer a technical review call if they'd like.

Samir (oncall): quick draft playbook snippet:
```
1) scale pool: k8s patch set min=3
2) run warmup: /opt/tools/warmup --prefix /customer-prefix
3) validate: curl /health -> kv hit-rate > 80% and p50 latency < 50ms
4) restore routing
```
Posting to runbook PR after this thread.

Leah H: ok — moving to post-incident follow-up. Please add notes to the postmortem doc and link to the tracking board. I’ll host the brown bag and cover the prevention patterns: autoscaler safety gates, warmup hooks, and per-customer burst profiles.

Kevin M: one more long-term follow-up: consider adding an infra metric that detects scale events during high QPS windows and auto-blocks scale-down until warm. I’ll prototype.

IncidentBot: Note created: incident-1939999999 (SEV2). Postmortem thread opened at 1939999999.

Leah H: Thanks everyone — excellent coordination. Closing this thread for live mitigation; moving discussion to postmortem doc for remediation tracking.

[Action item summary]
- AI-1: Revert autoscaler aggressive change (Kevin M) — done, monitored
- AI-2: Prevent scale-down under high QPS / add cooldown (Kevin M) — ETA 48h
- AI-3: Warmup endpoint and readiness warmup hook (Samir) — PR in progress, ETA EOD tomorrow
- AI-4: Oncall runbook snippet + runbook PR (Leah H) — in progress
- AI-5: Customer exec note + postmortem share (Maya S) — interim update sent, full postmortem in 48h

Leah H: postmortem doc link: /docs/incidents/incident-1939999999-postmortem (draft). Will ping when review calendar invite is up. :thumbsup:

Maya S (CS): adding customer note to the ticket now.

Samir (oncall): will follow up with PR link in this thread when ready.

Kevin M: monitoring looks stable. If anything changes, I’ll reopen the page.

Leah H: thanks again. end of thread.
